finalText:
**The build's green again.** Two real bugs, the rest was noise.

1. `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the bump renamed it to `retryCount`. It reads the new name now, falling back to the old one.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when the flag was unset. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`. An unset flag now counts as off.

The 8 warnings still print. They're hardcoded in `build.js` and name files this repo doesn't have.
